settings.title: Platform settings
settings.subtitle: Global keys and settings used by every business.
settings.adminsBody: Admins are regular accounts flagged as platform admins. The first one is enabled by putting its email in the PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS variable; others can then be flagged in the database.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.subtitle: Keys are stored encrypted and never shown again. What you set here takes precedence over environment variables (.env).
ai.orderHelp: The first provider with a key is tried; if it fails, the next one. An agent with its own model uses that provider first.
ai.removeConfirm: Remove the {provider} key stored in the panel? If .env has one, that will be used.
ai.noneConfigured: No provider is configured: AI agents can't reply.

impersonation.viewing: You are viewing {name}'s account as a Whasalia admin
impersonation.logDescription: Internal record of when an admin opened a customer's account. The customer doesn't see it.
